item.title: December 1.0 (72)
item.description: - The preview now stays open as you move through a folder and switches to whatever is selected — a note, a photo, a PDF or a folder — instead of disappearing the moment the cursor leaves Markdown. It behaves like Finder's preview pane. - Markdown opened in Quick View is rendered as a document: headings, tables and highlighted code, not raw source. - The outline in the Markdown preview is off by default. The toolbar button opens it when you want it, and it stays closed for every new document. - Selecting text in the preview shows the system highlight, so what you are about to copy is always visible, whatever the theme. - Tab steps out of a preview back to the file list, and Esc closes it — the same on every preview surface.
